description: Source file implementing hardware capability queries for various system features such as cellular, WiFi, Ethernet, Bluetooth, ZigBee, audio, display, and clock support, utilizing build configurations and sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportCellularNetworks
methods.description: Checks if the device supports cellular radio communication, using build config or sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportWifiNetworks
methods.description: Checks if the device has WiFi capability, using build config or sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportWifiAcessPointMode
methods.description: Checks if the device supports WiFi Access Point mode, using build config or sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportEthernetNetworks
methods.description: Checks if Ethernet network is supported, using build config or sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportBluetooth
methods.description: Checks if Bluetooth radio is present via sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportZigBee
methods.description: Checks for ZigBee radio support, using build config or sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportSounds
methods.description: Checks if internal speaker for audible tones is supported, via build config or sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: hasDisplayScreen
methods.description: Checks if device has a display capable of UI presentation, using build config or sysinfo HAL.

methods.name: supportClockAlteration
methods.description: Indicates whether the device can alter system clock (always returns false).
